name: Outpost
description: A lightweight public posting board for sharing with the world. Editors publish short posts — a thought, a question, a status, an announcement, a quick poll, or an image / audio / video clip — and anyone with the frame's link reads them, attachments included. Anyone signed in votes in polls, listed viewers included; people who have not signed in see the live results. The owner sets the heading, the tagline and whether only they may post. Posts, media rows and votes are tables in the space's frame data folder (posts, post_media, post_votes); attachments are files beside them, one folder per post, served by the frame to everyone who reads the board.
